findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_file_upload_session" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_links, get_link_stats, save_short_link, save_html_file_qr, host_file, render_file_upload_qr_form · Private data: save_html_file_qr, host_file, save_file_url_qr, render_file_upload_qr_form, create_file_upload_session, save_whatsapp_link, save_email_link · Public sink: get_link_stats, save_html_file_qr, host_file, save_file_url_qr, render_file_upload_qr_form, create_file_upload_session, save_email_link · Destructive: save_whatsapp_link, delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_links, get_link_stats, save_short_link, save_html_file_qr, host_file, render_file_upload_qr_form · Private data: save_html_file_qr, host_file, save_file_url_qr, render_file_upload_qr_form, create_file_upload_session, save_whatsapp_link, save_email_link · Public sink: get_link_stats, save_html_file_qr, host_file, save_file_url_qr, render_file_upload_qr_form, create_file_upload_session, save_email_link · Destructive: save_whatsapp_link, delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
